validation.label: validation (DV2, aifoundry2, 28 Sep 20:45 PDT - 29 Sep 16:57 PDT): the frozen replication PREREG-VAL registered, as the frozen reducer decided it

I1.rule: PASS: >= 5 clean OUT cycles with high >= 66 over >= 3 OUT stretches and no clean IN cycle with mean <= 64; FAIL: >= 2 such IN cycles and they are >= 50% of the discriminating cycles

I2.rule: PASS: >= 10 idle ENTERs and >= 10 idle EXITs, every ENTER prints 66, every EXIT <= 65; FAIL: any other

I3.rule: PASS: >= 10 idle EXITs, each followed by a PIDLE as the next governor line, >= 90% within 0.30 s; FAIL: any other next line, or > 10% later than 0.30 s

I4.rule: PASS: >= 5 ENTER->EXIT intervals with k >= 1 and every interval within 0.015 s of k x 0.4053 s; FAIL: > 10% off that grid

I5.rule: PASS: >= 3 ENTERs whose previous governor line is a PIDLE or an EXIT, with no power_up, power_down or 'new OP' line within 30 s; FAIL: none while >= 3 cycle pairs show the mean rising from <= 64 to >= 66

I6.rule: PASS: >= 3 idle intervals with >= 1 completed episode, every one within 5 ms; FAIL: any more than 50 ms off, or > 10% outside 5 ms

G1-T.rule: PASS: >= 6 separating runs over >= 3 blocks, >= 80% fit H-mean, <= 1 fits H-max; FAIL: >= 50% fit H-max

G1-H.rule: PASS: >= 3 runs over >= 2 blocks hold 800 MHz >= 1.0 s after a sample at 800 with the high >= 67; FAIL: >= 6 runs reach a high >= 67 at 800 MHz and none holds

G4-S.rule: PASS: the 99% CI of the block-mean L lies wholly above 0 (>= 6 blocks); FAIL: wholly within +-0.05

G4.rule: PASS: the 99% CI of the block-mean L lies inside L_pred +- b (>= 16 blocks); FAIL: wholly outside

G2-C.rule: >= 20 climbs; >= 95% show 700 in <= 1 sample and >= 25% none

G2-U.rule: >= 20 up-steps; the preceding reading <= 66 in 100%, <= 65 in >= 80%, never >= 67

G3-L.rule: >= 10 launches; median in [0.4, 1.0] s and all <= 2.2 s

G3-I.rule: >= 10 runs ending at 800 MHz with no trip; every kernel end -> 600 in [0, 1.6] s
